source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not directly runnable with a single stock high-level command: PWR_MB_CPU0_~PWR_MB_CPU1_ requires raw/implementation-specific IPMI bytes + exact expected output which the library has not specified; give exact bytes/result to run.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED for malformed target and absent command/workload contract.

original_test_intent: Correlate motherboard CPU0 and CPU1 power-sensor changes with an approved CPU workload and verify threshold/protection behavior.
original_method: Boot the host, load the CPU/platform driver, stress the CPUs and read BMC power sensors through IPMI.
manual_activity: Engineer confirms the CPU sensor map and safe workload envelope; automation can then run workload, sample both sensors and collect recovery evidence.
required_inputs: Approved CPU workload and power/thermal limits
safety_requirements: Use only a verified read path for BMC sensors.
Bound workload and monitor CPU temperature, power and host health.
Stop on protection or unexpected error; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Run the approved stress plan and time-align CPU0/CPU1 sensor, OS telemetry, SEL, fan and console evidence.
Do not infer malformed names or decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly non-runnable; no raw bytes may be guessed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the platform-documented sensor read interface and an approved CPU stress package.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU0/CPU1 targets, stress concept, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline both CPU rails, run a bounded CPU workload, correlate per-socket power/thermal/SEL data, stop safely and verify recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform sensor map and CPU power/thermal limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-socket identity and synchronized OS/BMC evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains both CPU channels and protection coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stress can trigger power or thermal protection.

project_override_considerations: An approved shorter duration or alternate workload is acceptable if actual CPU0/CPU1 coverage is recorded.
expected_evidence: CPU sensor map and approved plan

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Trailing underscores are malformed naming but the two-CPU target remains intelligible; no incompatible source requirement is present.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Map, command and workload are inputs, not an irreducible intent or safety ambiguity under locked V3.1.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its refusal to invent raw bytes.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automatable core from engineer-owned approval/verdict.

review_improvement: Requires per-socket identity and workload-correlated evidence instead of an unqualified SDR change.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once the sensor identities and approved workload are supplied, both stimulus and evidence collection are automatable; the malformed label does not prevent defining the two intended CPU channels.
